integrity: A complete formal generating-function proof and independently executable finite checks are provided. Finite enumeration is supporting evidence, not proof of the all-q asymptotic. Originality assessment is self-review only; independent validation is absent.
scientific_limitations: Fixed degree d, field size q tends through prime powers; O_d constant unspecified. No exact all-coefficient formula or uniform-in-d error is claimed.
title: The first correction to triple-product collisions of monic polynomials
